title: Forward-only test of two matrix-rule variants against the current rule
why: The audit (bot/data/research/audit_core_20260924.md, sections 4.3 and 4.4; findings RULE-7, combos-5, combos-6) found two post-hoc patterns in the current matrix rule: the event-setup layer (fd and sq in particular) did slightly worse than the plain z/vote rule, and 1d shorts taken when RSI14 < 30 did badly. Both were found after many comparisons on the same archives (data-mined), and no verdict changed. The archives, including the 2026 holdout, cannot test them without bias, so they are tested only on decisions recorded from now on.
state_at_registration: No variant decision has been recorded and the variant ledger does not exist. No variant statistic has been computed on any bar dated 2026-01-01 or later. The only evidence is the in-sample audit numbers cited above.
rule: The current matrix rule exactly as the decision table and bot/data/decision_ledger.jsonl record it: decision.from_analysis on engine.analyze over the live 420 closed Binance spot bars; the event setup (engine.setup_signal) of the last 2 closed bars, else the z/vote rule. The table and the main ledger stay on the rule basis: a side forced by the action policy is never recorded as the rule's decision.

variants.V1_z_only: The current rule with the setup layer removed, on every timeframe (5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d): decision = the z/vote rule of decision.side_series only. Long if z >= 1.2 and at least 3 of the 5 votes are bullish and at most 1 is bearish; short if z <= -1.2 and at least 3 are bearish and at most 1 is bullish; otherwise wait. The 5 votes are s_trend >= 0.30, s_mom >= 0.25, s_vol >= 0.25, s_struct >= 0.50 (engine.votes_at) and the causal kNN vote s_ml >= 0.2 (engine.knn_ml on the same 420-bar window); bearish votes are the mirror.
variants.V2_d1_no_short_rsi30: The current rule, except on 1d: no short when RSI14 (engine.rsi(c, 14)) at the decision bar is below 30; that bar becomes wait, with no fallback. On 5m, 15m, 1h and 4h V2 is the rule by definition, so only its 1d decisions are recorded.

data: Only decisions recorded after the recording code ships. t0 = the 'start' row that the recorder writes once into bot/data/decision_variants_ledger.jsonl. The rule's comparison trades are the rule-basis (rule/setup) rows of the main decision ledger recorded at or after t0. No archive bar and no 2026 holdout bar is used.
recording: At every decision cycle, for each fresh decision cell the main ledger sees (candle at most 3 bars old, the same staleness guard), V1 and V2 are computed from the same engine.analyze output, i.e. the same live klines window the rule used. Their long/short decisions are appended to bot/data/decision_variants_ledger.jsonl (append-only; id = variant|symbol|tf|candle_ts|side; never rewritten). A bar where the variant waits but the rule trades is logged as a 'skip' row, so the bars where a variant differs from the rule can be counted.
trade_simulation: Identical to the main decision ledger and resolved by the same code path (decision._resolve_one): same live bars and venue (Binance spot), entry at the open of the bar after the signal bar, bracket.levels / bracket.signal_trade semantics (stop 1.3 x ATR14 with a 0.25% floor = 1R, target 1.8R, 40-bar cap), 0.14% round-trip cost, one open trade at a time per variant x coin x timeframe (decision._cell_stats; the rule's stream is built the same way).
endpoint: Difference in mean net R per trade, variant minus rule, over the same period (t0 to the judgement time), counting resolved trades only.
test: Weekly-block bootstrap, one-sided. Blocks are UTC weeks starting Monday 00:00, assigned by each trade's signal candle_ts. The union of weeks holding a trade of either stream is resampled with replacement (same number of weeks) 10000 times with numpy default_rng seed 20260924; each replicate recomputes both means from the drawn weeks and takes the difference (replicates where either stream is empty are dropped). p = (1 + number of replicates with difference <= 0) / (1 + number of valid replicates). Pass if the observed difference > 0 and p <= 0.05.

judgement.V1: Judged once, pooled over 15m, 1h and 4h (all 5 coins), at the first ledger update when at least 26 weeks have passed since t0 AND the pool holds at least 300 resolved V1 trades. 5m and 1d are reported separately and not judged.
judgement.V2: Judged once, on 1d (the only timeframe where it can differ), at the first ledger update when at least 52 weeks have passed since t0. If by then at least 10 bars exist where V2's decision differs from the rule's, the test above is run; otherwise the result is 'inconclusive' and final.

judgement_record: Each judgement is appended once to bot/data/decision_variants_ledger.jsonl as a 'judgement' row and is final; the result is not recomputed on later data.
authority: A pass only labels the variant ('passed the forward test'). The rule is not changed automatically. This test never writes gates.json and is never read by the autotrader.
closed_family: Exactly these two variants. No other variant may be added to this test later; any new variant needs its own pre-registration and its own t0.
